admission.justification: The brief assembly, the projection and the publication sit in three modules that can drift apart, and each promise fails silently on its own; the first-message matrix builds every combination from the code and fails on a broken projection, an over-budget one, a repeat, or a name it cannot reach.

applicability: Every role a start operation launches, on every harness and in every kind of start: parentless, parented above a leaf, parented leaf seat, seat set, held seat opening, successor, step-up and the restore of a saved launch.
conditions: The projection's field list (PROJECTION_FIELDS and HOST_FIELDS) is defined once in code and excludes long prose fields retained in .handover.json.
The projection stays within its role token budget and the complete Turn-1 prompt stays within PHASE_1_WIRE_TOKEN_CEILINGS plus approved appendix allowances (600 held, 900 launch) under o200k_base.
The static prefix before ## Launch Context is byte-identical across launches of the same role and operation, and the artifact locator line stands last.
exclusions: A harness's own additions to a session.
The capsule's own word budget, which its record states.

evidence: notes/reports/reviewer/aac4a724-05d2-51de-bbfb-348a6e27892f/L185-A4-fix-verification-verdict.md; L185-R4-reviewer-record.md; L185-A4-fix-dispositions.json; retained A2 routes plus evidence/a4 raw runs and owner-ruling qualifications

statement: A role first message places its static brief, direction, AR tool guidance, role-filtered shared block, and compiled capsule before the ## Launch Context boundary, keeps its inline handover projection within the role token budget while publishing the complete canonical handover immutably, caps direct and held opening appendices by settings.role_message_limit with immutable offload sidecars, appends the handover artifact locator line as a trailing suffix, and stays within the Phase 1 wire-token ceilings.
title: Turn-1 role messages lead with static instructions and bound dynamic context
